turns.text: Get the calls I have at 7:45.
turns.rephrase: I mean: find the calls at 7:45.
I mean: take the first one.

turns.text: Find out who that call is with.
turns.rephrase: I mean: get the person it is with.

turns.gold:
PROCEDURE proc_22(time:TIME)
$v0 = FIND CALL WHERE PARENT.WHEN={time}
$v1 = FIRST $v0
$v2 = GET $v1 WHO
RETURN $v2
END
turns.name: proc_22
